サッカーが退屈なら、ゴールの代わりに右足を見る――Finding the next beat

What if football feels boring because we are waiting for goals instead of noticing actions? 足の触れ方、body orientation、scanningを追うと、one pass becomes a sequence of decisions. The same question reaches everyday life: how do you start an overwhelming task such as leaving home? Research on implementation intentions and action chunking suggests a more nuanced answer. Start small, connect steps, and stop micromanaging once the sequence flows.
